meta.name: genomic-intelligence
meta.description: Predict regulatory features, gene structure, and expression directly from DNA sequence using Genomic Intelligence's hosted transformer DNA language models — no local GPU or model weights. Six tasks over a REST API and a hosted MCP server (keyless public demo): promoter regions, splice donor/acceptor sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, sequence-to-expression (log TPM), and de-novo gene annotation, plus a composite find-genes-then-predict-expression workflow. Use when the user has a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a DNA/FASTA sequence and wants any of these predictions, mentions Genomic Intelligence, genomicintelligence.ai, api.genomicintelligence.ai, or mcp.genomicintelligence.ai.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测DNA序列的调控特征和基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要进行DNA序列的功能预测
copy.tagline_en: Predict regulatory features and gene expression from DNA sequences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to predict functional features from DNA sequences

howto.what: 你提供 DNA 序列、基因名或基因组区域后,Claude 会调用云端模型,返回启动子、剪接位点、增强子活性、染色质状态、表达量(TPM)和基因注释等预测。推理在远程完成,本地不需要 GPU 或模型权重。
howto.when: 当用户给出基因符号、基因组区域或 DNA/FASTA 序列并要求相应预测,或提到 Genomic Intelligence、genomicintelligence.ai 等名称时触发。

say.text: 预测基因 TP53 的启动子区域。
say.note: 会先取该基因序列,再预测启动子。

say.text: 帮我预测 HBB 基因在 K562 细胞中的表达量。
先找这段 DNA 中的基因,再预测它们在 K562 细胞的表达量。
say.note: 会先找基因,再逐个预测表达量。

howto.what_en: Given a gene symbol, region, or DNA/FASTA, Claude uses GI's cloud model to predict promoters, splice sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, expression, and gene annotation. No local GPU.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a DNA/FASTA sequence and asks for a matching prediction, or mentions Genomic Intelligence or genomicintelligence.ai.

say_en.text: Predict promoter regions for the TP53 gene.
say_en.note: Fetches that gene's sequence and runs promoter prediction.

say_en.text: Predict HBB expression in K562 cells.
say_en.note: Builds the TSS-centred 9,198 bp window and predicts expression.

say_en.text: Find genes in this DNA, then predict their expression in K562 cells.
say_en.note: Finds genes first, then predicts expression per gene.
